name: Tietze Syndrome
definition: Rare benign painful swelling of one or more upper costochondral junctions, distinguished from typical costochondritis by visible or palpable swelling.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical after exclusion of serious alternatives.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound/MRI may be used for atypical swelling.

amber: Persistent/enlarging swelling requires reassessment for infection or tumour.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Urah-shotha phenotype may be documented descriptively after serious causes are excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Rare benign painful swelling of one or more upper costochondral junctions, distinguished from typical costochondritis by visible or palpable swelling.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
